German Study Verbs: A2 Vocabulary Exercises

Learn wiederholen, markieren, nachschlagen and zusammenfassen for studying in German. Practise meanings with translations and explained A2 questions.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Vocabulary and usage

Wiederholen means to repeat or review, markieren to highlight or mark, nachschlagen to look up and zusammenfassen to summarise. Nachschlagen and zusammenfassen separate in a main clause: Ich schlage das Wort nach; ich fasse den Text zusammen. After möchte or muss, use the complete infinitive.

Common mistake to avoid

Nachschlagen means consulting a reference, such as a dictionary. It does not mean simply reading a text again; that can be wiederholen or noch einmal lesen.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice each word’s meaning, article and common word partners in context.

Worked example 1Vor dem Unterricht wiederhole ich die neuen Wörter.Before the lesson I review the new words.
Worked example 2Sie markiert die wichtigsten Sätze gelb.She highlights the most important sentences in yellow.
Worked example 3Ich schlage den Ausdruck im Wörterbuch nach.I look up the expression in the dictionary.
Worked example 4Wir fassen den Absatz in zwei Sätzen zusammen.We summarise the paragraph in two sentences.

Practice: choose the matching word

Choose the word from the bank that matches the English cue and sentence. Use each item once; keep its spelling and capitalisation. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: markieren · nachschlagen · wiederholen · zusammenfassen

Question 1. Die Wörter von gestern möchte ich ___. (review)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: wiederholen

Wiederholen means revisiting material already studied.

Question 2. Im Text sollst du die Schlüsselwörter ___. (highlight)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: markieren

Markieren means visually marking the key words.

Question 3. Das unbekannte Wort muss ich im Wörterbuch ___. (look up)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: nachschlagen

Nachschlagen describes consulting a dictionary or reference.

Question 4. Den langen Abschnitt sollst du kurz ___. (summarise)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: zusammenfassen

Zusammenfassen means giving the main points in a shorter form.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
